ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixel distribution across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with sparse clusters of mid-to-high intensity (light gray) mottled pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast, light-gray mottled clusters are distributed non-uniformly across the medial regions of both lobes, with increased intensity density observed toward the distal tips and the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis; depth is visible and sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 8 pixels along the entire trailing edge; topography becomes increasingly jagged and complex at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep from the median notch, displaying a concave curve on the inner trailing edge transitioning to a convex curve toward the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white and tan pixels forming irregular circular patterns located at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, low-contrast linear pixel streaks of lighter intensity oriented diagonally across the central-left fluke lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustations and associated morphological irregularities at the distal tips of both lobes; physical trauma or amputations are not detectable.
